P01.rationale: There are no human portraits on this page; it relies entirely on typography and abstract data visualizations.

P05.rationale: The page contains no case studies or client portraits to evaluate.

P07.rationale: There is no social-proof apparatus such as a press wall, rating cards, or testimonials present on this page.

P10.rationale: The layout features oversized decorative typographic elements in the form of large percentage figures (30-50%, etc.) at the bottom.

P11.rationale: The page contains real data visualizations bound to specific numbers and percentages rather than empty frames.

P12.rationale: The layout is dense and magazine-quality, filling the sheet with text blocks, headers, and a footer section without large gaps.

P13.rationale: The background is a flat, solid off-white color with no intentional texture or atmosphere applied.

P14.rationale: There are no full-bleed photos on this page to evaluate for treatment or readability of overlaid text.

P16.rationale: No device or product mockups (such as phones or laptops) are shown in the composition.

N07.rationale: The imagery consists entirely of typography and data; there is no generic stock photography to penalize.

N08.rationale: There is a small amount of dead whitespace in the middle section between the numbered list and the footer percentages.

N10.rationale: Text does not sit on busy photos; it sits cleanly on the flat background or within distinct containers.
